contexts.text: Saul mentioned. AC 4763:4. SE 1997. SE 2472. AE 951:2.
These things are said of Saul, because by him as a king is signified Divine truth. AE 195:10.
By Saul as a king () is meant truth protecting the Church. ( = the truth of the Church. AE 281:7.) ( = truth from good. AE 357:3.) ( = the Divine truth of the Church. AE 395:7.)
Saul (when the evil spirit was upon him) = the falsities opposed to spiritual truths; which were dispersed by the sound of a harp, because a harp = the affection of spiritual truth.
The sword of Saul () = truth from good.
